title: Statement of claim
ruleSource: Pleadings rules of the High Court of Lagos State (Civil Procedure) Rules 2019 and the FCT High Court (Civil Procedure) Rules, as set out in S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base) and the Civil Litigation Handbook 2025. To be confirmed by the legal reviewer.

parts.why: Names the court, the judicial division and where it sits; every process filed in the suit carries this heading. The Lagos and FCT High Courts are headed differently. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base); Civil Litigation Handbook 2025.

Names the court, the judicial division and where it sits; every process filed in the suit carries this heading. The Lagos and FCT High Courts are headed differently. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base); Civil Litigation Handbook 2025.

parts.text:
SUIT NO: ............
BETWEEN:
{{claimant}} .................... CLAIMANT
AND
{{defendant}} .................... DEFENDANT
parts.why: The suit number is left blank: the Registrar assigns it on filing, so counsel never writes one. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base) (drafting notes).

parts.instruction: In numbered paragraphs 1 to 3, introduce the Claimant (who they are and where they live or carry on business), then the Defendant, then the relationship between them, using only the facts given. Write in the third person, for example 'The Claimant is…'.
parts.why: The introductory averments (matters of inducement): the first three paragraphs introduce the claimant, the defendant and their relationship. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base) (statement of claim)
parts.heading: STATEMENT OF CLAIM

parts.instruction: Continue the numbered paragraphs from 4. State, in the order they happened, the material facts the Claimant relies on, one fact to a paragraph, in the third person (for example 'The Claimant avers that…'). Facts only: no law, no evidence and no arguments. Write dates and sums in figures.
parts.why: The body: the material facts relied on, in numbered paragraphs, stating facts and not law or evidence. Dates and numbers are written in figures. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base); Civil Litigation Handbook 2025.

parts.text: WHEREOF the Claimant claims against the Defendant as follows:
parts.why: Introduces the reliefs claimed. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.instruction: Set out the reliefs as (a), (b), (c)…, using only the facts given: each sum in figures and words, any interest with its rate and dates, and costs. Use orders rather than declarations, unless a declaratory right is claimed. Do not add a final omnibus relief; the template adds it.
parts.why: The prayer: the reliefs claimed, consistent with the writ. Use orders rather than declarations unless the right is declaratory. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: AND SUCH FURTHER ORDER OR ORDERS as this Honourable Court may deem fit to make in the circumstances.
parts.why: The omnibus relief, so the court may grant any other order the facts justify. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Left for the date of filing; a process is dated when it is filed. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Counsel signs the process; the space is left for the signature.

Counsel's name, chambers, address for service, email and phone number must appear on every process so the other side can serve documents. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Names who is to be served and where. Source: S.A Badmus' Civil Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Judicial division
fields.question: Which judicial division will the case be filed in? For example: Ikeja.

fields.label: Where the division sits
fields.question: Where does that division sit? For example: Ikeja, or Maitama in the FCT.

fields.label: Claimant
fields.question: Who is suing? Give the full name (or the company's registered name).

fields.label: Claimant's address
fields.question: Where does the claimant live or carry on business?

fields.label: Defendant
fields.question: Who is being sued? Give the full name (or the company's registered name).

fields.label: Defendant's address
fields.question: Where can the defendant be served?

fields.label: Relationship between the parties
fields.question: How are the claimant and defendant connected? For example: supplier and customer, landlord and tenant.

fields.label: What happened
fields.question: What happened, in order, with dates and sums?

fields.label: What the claimant wants
fields.question: What does the claimant want the court to order: sums, interest, damages, costs?

fields.label: Counsel's name
fields.question: Who is the legal practitioner signing this process?

fields.label: Counsel's chambers
fields.question: Which law firm or chambers is counsel in?

fields.label: Counsel's address for service and contacts
fields.question: Counsel's address for service, email and phone number.
